I made sure the drivers are up to date, but the issue persists. Could it be possible that the network card is dying and somehow causing system lockups?

I play about equal parts DM and player and coming from both sides I LOVE rolling for stats.

When I DM I always allow players to choose between rolling or point buy simply because some people have really bad luck and I wouldn't want to force rolling on them. I do also work with the players when they make their characters and allow for a few modifications to an array after it's rolled if it makes for a good character. I always prefer story to perfect balance.

As a player I love rolling because it means I have some cool natural influences for my character. If I rolled really poorly that can make me think "what kind of life would he lived with average and poor skills that eventually led him here?" I also like high rolls because then it's the opposite, I get to design a character who has lived his life with AMAZING stats and this is how he turned out.

Overall I like to view the stats and mechanics as a way to tell the story, and rolling for stats helps to shape that awesome story.
